name: remember
description: Save something the user states about themselves (a fact, preference, routine, project or relationship) so FRED remembers it for good. Asks the user to confirm before saving.

text.description: the thing to remember, in the user's own words, as a short statement

examples: remember that I prefer dark mode
note that I work best in the morning
keep in mind that my sister's birthday is in March
don't forget I'm allergic to peanuts
save this: I study physics on tuesdays and thursdays
make a note that I'm working on a robotics project
not_for: setting a reminder for a time
